notes: In the Netherlands, 'rij' is the standard word for both a line of people waiting and a physical row of objects. It is very common in shopping contexts when waiting to pay.
Do not confuse 'rij' with 'lijn', which usually refers to a physical line drawn on paper or a transport route.
